title: Obstacle Avoiding Robot
description: Build an autonomous obstacle avoiding robot using an ultrasonic sensor and motor driver. The robot detects obstacles and changes direction automatically.
objectives: Measure distance using the HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor
Detect obstacles in front of the robot
Control two DC motors using the L293D motor driver
Move forward when no obstacle is detected
Stop and turn when an obstacle is detected
Understand autonomous navigation using sensors and actuators
